newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - World Airways cut, shares fall.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - World Airways cut, shares fall.

text.p: Alex. Brown & Sons Inc said it cut World Airways Inc to market perform from buy on Tuesday after the carrier said June flying levels came in lower than last year's figures.
-- Late Monday, World Airways said block hours fell to 3,446 in June compared with 3,810 last year. Average aircraft units and average daily utilization also fell for the month.
-- Flying levels for the second quarter were also lower compared with last year.
-- Stock dropped sharply in early trading, losing 17.4 percent of their value. Shares off 1-7/16 to 6-13/16.
